# Fort Worth Storage

> Gated, drive-up self storage at 229 N Beach St, Fort Worth, TX 76111. Units are rented 100% online. Serving Fort Worth neighborhoods including Riverside, Carter Riverside, Northside and the Stockyards, Polytechnic Heights, Meadowbrook and Downtown, plus Haltom City and Richland Hills.

Key facts:

- Drive-up units only; no climate-controlled units
- Unit sizes: 10x10, 10x20, 10x30, 20x20 and 20x30 (current availability and rates are shown live on the website)
- No security deposit, 12-month price lock guarantee, month-to-month leases
- Gated access 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily, 24/7 HD video monitoring
- Customer service 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily
- Phone: (817) 838-6781 · Email: info@storagefortworthtexas.com
